t: Solvent-based spray adhesive for fast and quick adhesion. Bonds with a wide variety of materials. Can be used on wood, concrete, stone, tiles, rubber, foam. metals, rigid plastics, polythene, canvas fabrics, carpet, cardboard, paper and cork.
